_about: The single source of truth for Milky's colour, spacing, radius and motion.
are both written from this file by DesignSystem/generate.mjs. Edit this, then run
`npm run tokens` (or Scripts/generate-tokens.sh). CI fails if the generated files drift.
Typography is deliberately NOT here — see DesignSystem/README.md. Apple's text styles
carry per-platform metrics and Dynamic Type that a table of point sizes would throw away.

color._about: Semantic roles, never raw hues. Every role resolves in both appearances.

surfaceSunken.use: A recessed band the content sits on

accentInk.use: The accent as a thin mark: text, carets, icons

onAccent.use: Text on an accent fill. Does not follow appearance

link.use: Outbound URLs. Internal links use accentInk

syntaxActive.use: Markdown punctuation on the caret's line

codeSurface.use: Inline code and fenced block ground

_about: The landing page rebuilds the Mac window in DOM. On the real app these surfaces are
system materials (NSVisualEffectView, .textBackgroundColor) and must stay that way —
hardcoding them in Swift is how an app stops looking native.

space._about: A 4pt grid with two half-steps for optical work inside controls.

radius._about: Continuous curvature on Apple platforms; the web approximates with border-radius.

motion._about: Short and few. Everything here must no-op under prefers-reduced-motion.

measure._about: Reading widths, in characters and points.
